tmp=$(mktemp -d) && cat > "$tmp/diag2.py" <<'EOF'
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_selection import f_classif, SelectKBest
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline

def load(p):
    t = np.loadtxt(p, delimiter=",", skiprows=1)
    return t[:, :-1], t[:, -1]

Xp, yp = load("data/pilot.csv")
Xh, yh = load("data/heldout.csv")
rng = np.random.RandomState(0)

# (a) Pilot ranks of heldout-strong features
Fp, _ = f_classif(Xp, yp); rank_p = np.argsort(np.argsort(-Fp))
Fh, _ = f_classif(Xh, yh); rank_h = np.argsort(np.argsort(-Fh))
strong = [j for j in range(500) if (lambda a: max(a,1-a))(roc_auc_score(yh, Xh[:, j])) >= 0.57]
strong.sort(key=lambda j: -max(roc_auc_score(yh, Xh[:, j]), 1-roc_auc_score(yh, Xh[:, j])))
print("heldout-strong features (single AUC>=0.57, top 15):")
for j in strong[:15]:
    a_h = max(roc_auc_score(yh, Xh[:, j]), 1-roc_auc_score(yh, Xh[:, j]))
    a_p = max(roc_auc_score(yp, Xp[:, j]), 1-roc_auc_score(yp, Xp[:, j]))
    print(f"  x{j+1}: heldout AUC {a_h:.3f}  pilot AUC {a_p:.3f}  pilot F-rank {int(rank_p[j])+1}  in pilot top50: {rank_p[j] < 50}")

# (b) Honest nested CV on pilot: outer 5-fold, inner 4-fold picks K in {10,25,50}, screen inside every fold
for K in (10, 25, 50):
    pipe = make_pipeline(SelectKBest(f_classif, k=K),
                         RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=300, random_state=0, n_jobs=-1))
    outer = StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0)
    scores = cross_val_score(pipe, Xp, yp, cv=outer, scoring="roc_auc")
    print(f"K={K} RF300 nested-CV cv_auc {scores.mean():.4f} +- {scores.std():.3f}  folds {np.round(scores,3)}")
EOF
